summary: Exited at +20.5pts after price collapsed from a +81.25pt peak (frame 4) to +20.5pts by frame 11, a ~75% giveback, with two HA-against fires and a 73pt adverse leg amplitude confirming the reversal was structural, not noise. Held through several earlier pullbacks (giveback 24-45%) because with-trade fires (PROPP/HA) and positive 1m lambda kept dominating, but the accelerating two-frame drop (67.5->40.75->20.5) broke that pattern. Next time I'd watch cumulative giveback-from-peak (not just the per-leg reset metric) more closely and treat two consecutive HA-against fires plus rising ER10 (trendiness) as an earlier exit trigger rather than waiting for the move to nearly round-trip.
